messages:
Ravi: heads up  customers hitting a weird path where WS close -> immediate reconnect ends up as a fresh session and double-charge.
Lina: saw spikes too. traces show client gets a CLOSE with code 4001 and no resume hint; client auths again instead of resuming.
Oscar: are we sending a resume-allowed flag in close frames? thought we had that in the spec.
Ravi: we added it in runtime v2 but proxy strips custom close payload for some edge LB flows. repro steps: open WS, force server close with resume payload, client reconnects and does full auth. minimal logs:
Ravi: ```
Server -> CLOSE code=4001 payload={"resume":true, "resume_token":"rt-9"}
Proxy -> forwards only code, payload dropped
Client -> reconnects and does full auth -> new session token issued
Quota -> records new session charge
```
Lina: yikes. two issues: (1) proxy not preserving close payload, (2) quota/metering treats any reconnect with new auth as new charge.
Oscar: short-term: make proxy preserve close payload (or add a header on CLOSE -> X-Resume-Allowed) so clients know to attempt resume. I'll file a tiny proxy patch.
DeployBot: canary rollout 8% -> paused (errors +0) awaiting PR.
Ravi: medium-term: quota should accept a resume_fingerprint emitted on close and on resume requests and debounce charges for N seconds. That prevents double-charge when payload lost.
QuotaBot: note: current quota system dedupe keys only for creation API; resume path not wired into deduper.
Lina: telemetry mismatch too: console sampling for streams is 2% but billing is 100% so we can't correlate sampled traces to charges. we need a wireable resume_fingerprint on every billing event.
Oscar: agree. plan: (A) proxy preserve close payload or set X-Resume-Allowed header; (B) runtime attach resume_fingerprint to quota events (hash of resume_token + client_id); (C) quota-service debounce duplicates for 20s when fingerprint matches.
Ravi: add a feature flag "stream.resume_debounce" so we can enable for a small subset first. Also add a config for debounce window.
ConsoleUI: dashboard asks: new metric card "close_with_resume_payload" and "resume_successful" and a ratio panel. also surface current debounce flag value in the rollout UI.
Lina: tests: add e2e that server-sends-close-with-resume -> client reconnects within 5s and asserts single charge. also unit for proxy close payload passthrough.
Oscar: I'll push proxy PR now and target canary 5% only for a few minutes to prove payload preserved. then coordinate with Quota team to enable debounce flag in the same canary group.
QuotaBot: migration note: when debounce enabled, we will mark duplicate invoice events with "dedup=true" for audit. exports will have both raw and deduped counts for 48h.
Ravi: monitoring: alert if (resume_requests != unique_resume_fp) ratio > 1.01 for 5m. create a Grafana card and pager for >1.1 sustained 15m.
ConsoleUI: small UX: show last-close-payload JSON in session inspector so customers and support can see resume hint.
Lina: also low-risk opt: if close payload is missing and client auths again within 3s, quota-service could consult last-close-record for client_id to detect likely resume and avoid charge. caveat: privacy and storage TTL needed.
Oscar: good point, we'll prefer fingerprint in events over storing full payload. cheaper and safer.
Ravi: ok assignments: Oscar -> proxy fix + canary, Lina -> quota debounce design + tests, ConsoleUI -> dashboard + session inspector, QuotaBot -> implement dedupe and dedup exports. follow up in 8h. :thumbsup:
